project.title: Pure manual journal and rule-version validation
project.goal: Shared manual posting invariants without writer authority
project.scope: R09 pure manual foundation;full platform remains active.

boundary.responsibility: Typed manual journal and rule-version evaluation
boundary.rationale: One shared exact manual posting policy across interfaces.

action.manual_journal.description: Evaluate typed manual journal against explicit trusted facts

preconditions: Strict typed values;complete trusted caller snapshot;no client-supplied authority;known policy versions.
postconditions: Deterministic complete result or typed refusal;no effects or posting authority.

authorization.rationale: Facts are trusted caller inputs,not product endpoint claims;pure ok grants no authority.

boundaries.rationale: Exact values,full-width identity,context completeness and rule version gates.

concurrency.rationale: No shared state;actual transactional snapshot/revalidation remains caller obligation.

action.manual_journal.behavior: Evaluate typed manual journal against explicit trusted facts
